concept_activity_notification: ActivityNotification is a notification class documented in NOTIFICATIONS.md that delivers activity alerts, part of the real-time notifications implementation.
concept_admin_panel: The Admin Filament panel is the default tenant-scoped Filament panel composed from enabled modules' plugins, described in the Module Development Guide.
concept_adr_exceptions_none: ADR exceptions: none (§6) records that the conformance spec grants no exceptions to the architecture decision record's rules.
concept_advanced_search: Advanced search across users, posts and groups is the feature covered by the Advanced Search Architecture and Functionality documentation.
concept_alpinejs_frontend_choice: Alpine.js for the messaging UI documents the frontend framework choice for the private messaging web interface.
concept_api_vs_web_route_split: Separate API (Sanctum) and web (session) routes describes the messaging system's dual authentication route split between token-based API access and session-based web access.
concept_broadcasting_pusher: Pusher broadcasting driver is the real-time notification transport documented as part of the notification system's broadcast services.
concept_code_audit: Code-level conformance audit is the review documented in CODE-CONFORMANCE.md that ranks findings by consequence across the package fleet.
concept_composer_install_clobber_trap: Root composer install clobbers tracked packages documents a pitfall where running composer install at the root overwrites the tracked modules/themes directories.
concept_composer_unprefixed_package_nami: Composer name unprefixed, GitHub repo carries module- prefix documents that the real-estate-offers package's Composer name omits the module- prefix its GitHub repository uses.
concept_contract_package: Contract packages are small Composer packages (e.g. analytics-contracts, localization-contracts) that define adapter interfaces for implementation independence between modules.
concept_csrf_protection: CSRF protection on state-changing requests documents the messaging web interface's use of Laravel's CSRF middleware for mutating requests.
concept_dashboard_widgets: Admin dashboard widgets are Filament panel widgets covered in the Implementation Summary as part of the admin user-management enhancement.
concept_divergence_audit: The 48-of-48 divergence audit found that all 48 tracked packages had diverged from their published sources, motivating the module-repo-first conformance policy.
concept_filament_plugin_declaration: The filament_plugins manifest declaration is the module.json field naming a module's admin/app Filament plugin classes for ModulePlugins to instantiate.
concept_filament_presentation_module: A companion *-filament presentation module holds the Filament UI for a domain module, keeping the domain package presentation-agnostic.
concept_foundation_boundaries: Three foundation boundaries are the architectural boundaries defined for the composition host in the Foundation Compliance documentation.
concept_foundation_filament_dissolved: foundation-filament dissolved records that the former foundation-filament package was broken apart, its responsibilities moved elsewhere including App\Support\ThemeColors.
concept_friend_request_notification: FriendRequestNotification is a notification class documented in NOTIFICATIONS.md delivering queued friend-request alerts.
concept_github_issue_tracker: GitHub Issues on liberusoftware/boilerplate-laravel is the canonical issue tracker, driven by the gh CLI per docs/agents/issue-tracker.md.
concept_host_measures_host: The host measures the host records that coverage and CI gates in this repository apply only to app/, not to the vendored modules/themes packages.
concept_language_switcher: LanguageSwitcher is a Livewire component in localization-core-livewire for switching the active locale, not yet mounted anywhere in the application.
concept_laravel_echo_client: A Laravel Echo client listener is the browser-side subscriber documented for real-time notification delivery over private user broadcast channels.
concept_localization_modules: The localization module split divides localization functionality across several liberu-module Composer packages, per Multi-Language Support Documentation.
concept_manifest_derived_enablement: Discovery and enablement derive from manifests (§3.6) is the conformance rule that a module's default_enabled flag in its manifest, not host config, determines whether it boots.
concept_messaging_api_endpoints: Messaging REST API endpoints are the Sanctum-authenticated HTTP routes documented in MESSAGING.md for the private messaging system.
concept_messaging_tests: Messaging test suites are the automated tests covering the private messaging system's architecture, referenced in MESSAGING_ARCHITECTURE.md.
concept_migrate_testbench_script: scripts/migrate-testbench is a script documented in a handoff for migrating packages to use liberusoftware/package-testbench.
concept_module_categories: Module categories classify modules (e.g. domain, presentation) as described in the Module Development Guide alongside the module.json manifest.
concept_no_conversation_table: No conversations table documents that the messaging schema tracks conversations implicitly via the messages table rather than a dedicated table.
concept_no_laravel_auto_discovery: No extra.laravel.providers auto-discovery documents that module packages deliberately omit Laravel's auto-discovery so enablement stays an explicit host decision.
concept_packagist_blocker: The Packagist namespace registration blocker is an obstacle noted in a handoff that delayed publishing liberusoftware/package-testbench to Packagist.
concept_password_auto_hashing: Password auto-hashing on save documents that the user model's password attribute is automatically hashed when saved, noted in the admin panel implementation summary.
concept_provider_neutral_portal_integrat: The provider-neutral portal integration boundary keeps the real-estate-onthemarket module's domain core independent of any specific portal provider's implementation.
concept_search_controller: SearchController is the HTTP controller documented in SEARCH_ARCHITECTURE.md that exposes the search API endpoints backed by SearchService.
concept_selective_column_loading: Selective column loading is a SearchService performance optimization that limits queried columns, documented in Search Performance Optimization.
concept_shared_pint_phpstan: Shared Pint and PHPStan configs via --config documents that every package points at liberusoftware/package-testbench's shared configuration rather than committing its own.
concept_supported_locales_config: config('app.supported_locales') lists the application's enabled locales (en/es/fr/de), used by the LanguageSwitcher and SetLocale middleware.
concept_tenancy_rules: Tenancy rules that bite lists the Filament Shield and Spatie Permission tenancy pitfalls documented in CLAUDE.md, such as isScopedToTenant overrides.
concept_theme_accessibility_requirements: Theme accessibility requirements are the accessibility standards themes must meet, documented alongside semantic design tokens in Theme Architecture.
